verdict.rationale: Claude has its own persistent memory: it carries context from past chats into new conversations and Cowork tasks, and users can review, edit, and toggle what is saved. Projects and project files add persistent workspace context, and Skills apply repeatable instructions. However, nothing in the evidence shows an explicit custom-instructions or personal-preferences setting applied to every response; memory is chat-derived and Projects are scoped to one workspace. Missing for 10: a documented global custom-instructions or preferences field, evidence that it applies to every response across all chats, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
